prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 93.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 31.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Preparation & Render Stage Screen: Add a dedicated stage screen setup during the waiting step showing live setup progress while pet assets generate. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and median waiting time is long (201s / 395s), with users unsure if the pet will show up on their desktop.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Quick Control Interactive Checklist: Redesign the home intro finish screen to a checklist layout detailing pet control shortcuts (hide, summon, talk). (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Card View Path Selection with Preview Badges: Change the choose_path screen layout to card layout with animated pet badges previewing each path choice. (why: Choose path has a mean time of 514s indicating some users hesitate when deciding their path.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Quality Live Validation Stage: Add real-time photo quality status badges and guidance inside the photo upload screen to prevent failed generations. (why: 3 support emails complained that custom pet generation fails or looks wrong during adoption.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Overlay Permission & Ready Alert: Enable ready notifications and display clear desktop permission toggle during waiting stage. (why: 3 support emails reported pet does not show on desktop or app will not open when home screen finishes.)
5: [finish, hint] System Tray & Shortcut Hints on Intro Screen: Add persistent hint text explaining how to locate pet in the system tray and how to open pet settings. (why: Support emails cite post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling/hiding pets and desktop features misbehaving.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Multi-Device Account Protection Copy: Update headline and body on sign_in screen emphasizing zero data loss and multi-device sync safety. (why: 8 emails specifically note pets missing or reset after signing in again.)

scores.note: New screen addresses high waiting time but has zero support mail evidence.
Finish step has largest drop (35.2%) and is backed by 3 support emails.
Choose path already converts well (93.4%), low potential impact.
Adoption has high drop (30.1%) and direct support mail alignment.
Addresses home wait drop and permission issues backed by 3 emails.
Low cost hint addition targeting the biggest drop-off step (finish).
Copy change is very low cost and strongly supported by 8 support emails.
